Export Offline Package

Small package export tool, customizing the export path (the earliest version is 23.3.0).

Overview

The macle development plug-in integrates the function of exporting offline packages, which is different from the Package function. The offline package export path can be customized by developers.

Method

①: Click to open the main page for exporting offline packages.

②: Click to select the export package path.

③: Click to export data.
